    Holiday Season

    Holidays at the Tavern

    We’re dark two days a year so the crew can be with their families — Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. The rest of the season, the doors are open and the TVs are on.

    Holiday hours: Closed Thanksgiving Day — Thursday, November 26 and Christmas Day — Friday, December 25. Back open at 11:00 AM the next day, regular hours.

    Thursday · November 26

    Thanksgiving

    The tavern is closed for Thanksgiving so our crew can spend the day with their families. We’re thankful for every one of you — see you Friday.

    Closed

    Friday · December 25

    Christmas

    Closed for Christmas Day. Merry Christmas and happy holidays from all of us at Brew & Barrel — we’re back Saturday, December 26.

    Closed

    Thursday · December 31

    New Year’s Eve

    Celebrate the New Year with us — join us on New Year’s Eve with family and friends, the game on every TV and the bar pouring ’til 2:00 AM.

    The Scene

    Built for game day — and every day

    TVs, games, live music, and a front patio

    Brew & Barrel is the neighborhood sports bar at Pablo Station on Beach Blvd — the kind of place where the game is always on, the bartenders know the specials by heart, and most folks stay somewhere between 45 minutes and three hours.

    • Every game on — TVs around the room and the big screen up front, so your game is always in view.
    • Live music nights — good food, good drinks, and a fun atmosphere, as the regulars put it.
    • Outdoor seating — take the Florida weather with your pour.
    • Great cocktails — and a draft list priced for the neighborhood, most nights $20–30 a person.
    • Just walk in — no reservations; grab a seat at the bar or a table and settle in.
